Belgaum — officially renamed Belagavi but universally called Belgaum in trade and industry documentation — is Karnataka's northernmost major city. It sits on NH 48, the Bangalore–Pune national highway, at the exact point where Karnataka ends and Maharashtra begins. Every truck moving industrial goods between Pune's auto belt and Bangalore's electronics corridor passes through Belgaum. Every highway contractor on this stretch needs a site office. Every factory expanding in the Machhe or Udyambag industrial estates needs a security post and a supervisor cabin.

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures MS-frame steel porta cabins at our Gopasandra facility in Bangalore (560099) and dispatches directly to Belgaum. We are the manufacturer — ISO-certified, with three accredited quality certifications and over 500 completed prefab steel structure projects since 2009. Explore our porta cabin solutions or call us with your requirement and we quote the same day.

Belgaum is approximately 490 to 500 kilometres from our factory via NH 48. Transit to your delivery address is 5 to 6 days from dispatch. For a city at the edge of our South zone delivery radius, we supply regularly and the route is proven.

Belgaum's Industrial Profile — Where Site Offices and Security Cabins Are Needed

Belgaum has a distinct industrial character shaped by its geography. It is not a technology city or a port city. It is a foundry, engineering, and auto-component city that also sits on one of India's most important industrial freight highways. That combination creates specific and consistent demand for prefab steel structures.

Udyambag Industrial Area (PIN 590008): Located in the southern part of Belgaum city, Udyambag is one of Karnataka's older KSSIDC industrial estates. It hosts foundry units, iron and steel processors, general engineering workshops, and light manufacturing firms. The area has been industrially active for decades. Incremental factory expansion and shed construction inside Udyambag creates regular demand for temporary site offices during construction phases and for permanent security cabins at factory entries.

Machhe Industrial Area (PIN 590014): Machhe sits approximately 8 kilometres from Belgaum city centre on the Pune–Bangalore approach road. It is a newer and more planned estate compared to Udyambag, attracting auto component manufacturers, consumer goods units, and logistics operations. The Belgaum airport is nearby. New unit construction in Machhe has been steady, and every new factory build needs at minimum a site office for the construction phase and a security cabin at the gate for the operational phase.

NH 48 infrastructure corridor: The Bengaluru–Pune highway through Belgaum carries some of the heaviest freight tonnage in South India. Road widening, bridge replacement, and highway service facility construction on this stretch generates sustained demand for contractor site office cabins — typically 20 ft × 8 ft wired units placed at each active work front along the project stretch.

Defence and cantonment belt: Belgaum has a significant defence establishment. The civilian contractor and vendor ecosystem that supplies goods and services to defence operations in the city creates genuine demand for office cabins and security structures. We supply to civilian contractors working near the cantonment belt — not directly to defence procurement, which has its own separate channels.

Karnataka–Maharashtra crossover demand: Belgaum's border position means buyers from the adjoining Kolhapur and Sangli districts of Maharashtra also source from Belgaum-area suppliers. If your project is on the Maharashtra side of the border within reasonable range of Belgaum, our delivery to that address is feasible. Mention the exact location when enquiring.

Specifications — What Every SAMAN Porta Cabin Is Built From

Every cabin starts with the frame. Not the panels, not the roof, not the fittings — the frame. Because the frame is what everything else hangs on and what the 5-year structural warranty covers.

Frame: Mild steel IS 2062 grade hollow sections. Factory-cut to length, welded by trained fabricators, weld seams inspected before primer is applied. Anti-rust primer coat on all exposed metal. This is structural-grade steel — the same IS 2062 designation used in industrial shed purlins and commercial building columns.

Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel — polyurethane foam core, pre-painted steel skin on both faces. Provides thermal insulation and a finished interior and exterior surface in one component. Cement fibre board panels available as a higher-impact-resistance alternative for heavy-traffic or long-service installations.

Roof: GI sheet with zinc anti-corrosion coating. Single-skin standard. Double-skin available for sites with prolonged direct summer sun exposure. Belgaum's elevation (748 metres) means temperatures are milder than interior Tamil Nadu but the monsoon is significant — the GI roof with proper overlap and sealing handles normal monsoon rainfall without leakage.

Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet as standard. 18mm plywood-on-MS cross-members available for office use where a warmer and quieter underfoot surface is preferred. Tile floor in toilet compartments.

Doors: MS single-leaf or double-leaf with powder-coat finish and mortise lock. Painted wooden door with steel sub-frame available.

Windows: Sliding glass in aluminium section frame, fixed MS mesh vent, or jalousie louvre — any combination, specified at order stage.

Custom sizes built to your site footprint. If your Machhe or Udyambag plot has a specific entry clearance or space constraint, send us the dimensions and we engineer to fit.

Customisation — Every Detail Fixed Before Manufacturing Starts

A mini porta cabin handles a single security post at a factory gate. A 20 ft × 10 ft fully fitted cabin with electrical, AC provision, false ceiling, partition, and attached toilet serves as a senior project manager's site office. We build both from the same Bangalore factory. What changes is the specification you give us at enquiry stage.

Once production begins, no changes are possible. This is not a constraint — it is the reason the cabin that arrives at your Belgaum site is exactly what you ordered, built under quality management, with no improvised additions.

Electrical fit-out: Single-phase wiring designed to your declared load. MCB board with circuit breakers sized for your equipment — AC unit, computers, power tools, lighting. Earth leakage circuit breaker. Wall switches and sockets at positions specified on the layout drawing we share before cutting begins. LED fittings. Fan hanging point with speed regulator socket. External floodlight point for night-shift security posts.

Air conditioner provision: Panel cut-out at the height your split AC indoor unit requires. Bracket welded to the cabin exterior for the outdoor compressor unit. Copper pipe sleeve of the correct diameter through the panel. Condensate drain pipe at floor level. Your electrician installs the AC on site — we deliver the cabin ready to receive it. No drilling, no improvised openings.

False ceiling: 12mm plywood panel or PVC tongue-and-groove board on MS angle sub-frame. Reduces the internal air volume the AC has to condition. For site offices near the NH 48 highway where road noise is present, a false ceiling also provides meaningful acoustic dampening.

Toilet compartment: 4 ft × 4 ft or 5 ft × 4 ft wet room within or attached to the main cabin footprint. FRP water tank (500 or 1,000 litre) on roof frame. WC with cistern, wash hand basin, floor trap, and soil pipe outlet. 4-foot tile dado inside. Plumbing connected to your site water and disposal point by your plumber on delivery day.

Partition wall: Plywood or gypsum-on-stud frame dividing a long cabin into two separate rooms, each with its own door. Useful for highway contractors who need a combined manager office and document room in one 20 ft × 8 ft footprint.

Exterior finish and wind resistance: Primer plus two-coat gloss enamel in your colour. Company name board on exterior. Belgaum sits at 748 metres elevation and can experience strong crosswinds, particularly on exposed NH 48 sites. For cabins placed in open or elevated locations, we add diagonal wind-bracing angles inside the roof frame at no additional charge — mention it at enquiry stage.

Worker safety at our Bangalore facility meets certified international standards.

GST Registration: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR

Warranty: 5 years on structural MS frame and base. 1 to 2 years on finishing elements — panels, roofing sheet, paint. Engineered service life of the complete structure: 20 to 25 years under normal industrial site conditions.

More than 500 projects completed. For buyers in Belgaum who need vendor documentation for a factory audit or project tender, we supply certificate copies, GST registration, and NSIC papers as part of your order file.

Delivery to Belgaum

  • Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
  • Route: NH 48 north — Tumkur, Chitradurga, Davangere, Haveri, Dharwad, Hubli, then onward to Belgaum
  • Distance: approximately 490 to 500 kilometres
  • Transit: 5 to 6 days from dispatch to your Belgaum address

The cabin arrives on a flatbed truck. Offloading requires a crane or telehandler at your delivery point. A 5-tonne mobile crane handles cabins up to 20 ft × 8 ft with standard fit-out. Larger or heavier units need 7.5 tonnes. We provide exact cabin weight and lifting markings with your delivery note so you book the right equipment.

Placement: a levelled hard surface is sufficient for temporary or semi-permanent use. For permanent KIADB or KSSIDC plot installations in Machhe (590014) or Udyambag (590008), we include anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and supply the bolt pattern drawing to your civil team in advance.

We deliver to Machhe Industrial Area (590014), Udyambag Industrial Area (590008), the cantonment belt, and all Belgaum / Belagavi city and district addresses including locations in the Gokak, Bailhongal, and Khanapur taluks. For industrial estate entries requiring vehicle advance authorisation, share the entry procedure and contact when placing your order — we coordinate with your site team.

Our our porta cabin range covers all sizes and fit-out levels available from our Bangalore facility. South Karnataka pages with live delivery records: porta cabin in Hubli and porta cabin in Mangalore.

Pricing — How Your Belgaum Quotation Is Built

No price is published here because every cabin is built to your specification and every price is specific to that specification. Here is exactly what determines what you pay.

Size: External footprint and height. All material and labour cost scales proportionally with size. No arbitrary mark-up for larger cabins — just the actual material increase.

Panel type: 40mm PUF sandwich panel is the standard and most cost-effective choice. Cement fibre board is heavier, more impact-resistant, and carries a modest material premium. Both are available for any size.

Fit-out level: Bare MS structure with door and window is the base. Fully wired, AC-ready, partitioned, false-ceilinged, toilet-attached cabin is at the other end. Every item between those two points adds cost in direct proportion to material and labour — nothing is padded.

Doors and windows: Standard is one door and one window. Each additional door, extra window, or special opening adds to cost in proportion to material.

Freight: Belgaum is 490 to 500 kilometres from our factory. Freight for a small cabin is lower than for a large heavy unit. We quote freight as a separate line item — no hidden transport charges added at delivery.

Send your size, use, quantity, and Belgaum delivery address. Written quotation with complete line-item breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you deliver porta cabins to Machhe Industrial Area, Belgaum?

Yes. We deliver to Machhe Industrial Area (PIN 590014) and Udyambag Industrial Area (PIN 590008) and all Belgaum and Belagavi addresses. For industrial estate entries requiring vehicle advance authorisation, provide the gate-pass contact and procedure when placing your order. We coordinate the delivery vehicle timing with your site team so there is no waiting at the estate gate.

How long does manufacturing and delivery take from Bangalore to Belgaum?

Standard sizes with no customisation: 7 to 10 working days manufacture, then 5 to 6 days in transit. Custom cabins with electrical, AC provision, partition, or toilet: 12 to 18 working days manufacture, then 5 to 6 days transit. We confirm production start date and expected dispatch date in writing when you place the order — not an estimate, a committed schedule we hold ourselves to.

Do you supply to highway project sites between Pune and Belgaum on NH 48?

Yes. We supply to highway and infrastructure project sites along the NH 48 corridor both in Karnataka and into the adjoining Maharashtra belt near Kolhapur. For multi-site projects where you need cabins at several active work fronts along the highway stretch, we plan the manufacturing batch and dispatch sequence so each site receives its cabin on schedule. Call us with the project scope — number of cabins, sizes, site locations — and we build the supply plan.

Can you supply documentation for a Belgaum project tender or factory audit?

Yes. We provide ISO certificate copies (9001, 14001, 45001), NSIC registration certificate, DPIIT recognition letter, and GST registration document as part of your order file. If your tender requires a manufacturer's declaration or material compliance statement, request it when placing the order and we include it with your delivery paperwork.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Belgaum, Belagavi, Machhe, Udyambag, or the NH 48 Pune corridor:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. When using the enquiry form, include your cabin size, intended use, quantity, and delivery address — we return a complete written quotation without needing a follow-up call for the basics.
